```{r}
    library(networkdata)
    library(igraph)
    g <- flo_marriage + flo_business
    g <- subgraph(g, which(degree(g) > 1))
```


```{r}
    set.seed(345)
    png("medici.png", width = 800, height = 600)
    plot(g, 
        vertex.size=8, vertex.frame.color="lightgray", 
        vertex.label.dist=2, edge.curved=0.2, 
        vertex.label.cex = 1.2, edge.color = "gray",
        edge.width = 1.5)
    dev.off()
```


```{r}
   prestige.sim <- function(x, alpha = 0, beta = 0) {
      A <- as.matrix(as_adjacency_matrix(x))
      A.p <- A %*% A 
      A.q <- A %*% (1 - A)  
      S <- A.p / (A.p + A.q + t(A.q))
      D <- 1 - S
      W <- A * (S^alpha * D^beta)
      s <- abs(eigen(W)$vectors[, 1])
      names(s) <- rownames(A)
      s <- (s - min(s))/(max(s) - min(s))
      return(list(s = s, D = D, S = S, W = W))
   }
```

```{r}
    res <- prestige.sim(g, alpha = 0.25, beta = 0.25)
    plot(as.vector(res$W))
```

```{r}
    bon <- prestige.sim(g, alpha = 0, beta = 0)
    ace <- prestige.sim(g, alpha = 0, beta = 1)
    ol1 <- prestige.sim(g, alpha = 1, beta = 0)
    ol2 <- prestige.sim(g, alpha = 0.15, beta = 0.85)
    sort.vec <- function(x) {
        x <- data.frame(Node = names(x), Score = as.numeric(x))
        x <- x[order(x$Score, decreasing = TRUE), ]
        return(x)
        }
    eig.dat <- data.frame(sort.vec(bon$s), sort.vec(ace$s), sort.vec(ol1$s), sort.vec(ol2$s))
    library(kableExtra)
    library(here)
    kbl(eig.dat,
        format = "html",
        row.names = FALSE, align = rep(c("l", "c"), 4),
        digits = 3, col.names = c("Node", "Eig.", "Node", "Eig./Dis", "Node", "Eig./Sim", "Node", "Eig./Both"),
        caption = "Eigenvector-Based Scores for the Medici Network.", label = "tab:main") %>%    
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = 
                    c("hover", "condensed", "responsive"))
```

```{r}
    save_kable(
        kbl(eig.dat,
            format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "",
            row.names = FALSE, align = rep(c("l", "c"), 4),
            digits = 3, col.names = c("Node", "Eig.", "Node", "Eig./Dis", "Node", "Eig./Sim", "Node", "Eig./Both"),
            caption = "Eigenvector-Based Scores for the Medici Network.", label = "tab:main") %>%    
            kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down")),
        file = here("main.tex")
        )
```


```{r}
    dist.diff <- function(x) {

        return(x)
        }
    b <- sapply(seq(0, 1, .01), dist.diff)
```
